I love how this game embraces the retro look while adding mechanics that no other games have. I can see this game becoming popular if enough is added and revamped. I recommend this game to everyone that enjoys a realistic hunting game! 

P.S. If a developer looks at my comment I have a few recommendations... add more animals that can be hunted like turkeys, bears, etc, rework some of the deer's animations (walking specifically), expand the season a bit to make it feel more realistic.

Don't let the somewhat "classic" graphics turn you off. This game is extremely immersive, and is most accurately described as a "Deer Hunting Simulator". It isn't particularly easy, or arcade-y. It's a whole lot like huntin'! The level of detail is very impressive. From the mechanics, to animal behavior, and the unique rack generation. There was clearly a whole lot of love put into this game. Starting in the early season, progressing through the rut, and ending in the snowy winter is very cool. The overall experience is very immersive. For $8? This game is a must buy for any hunting / hunting game enthusiast!

Great game, with an extremely passionate, hardworking and kind singular Dev. 
This game is still being actively worked on, improved and updated *constantly*. It’s extremely impressive to see! If you experience a bug or issue, the developer is very responsive and gets out fixes asap.
As someone who has played a lot of hunting games, this game reminds me of a modern version of some old classics, and has some awesome features that even bigger titles currently do not. It’s truly hugely impressive for a dev team of one person to make a game like this, and be as fast and responsive as they are (there’s a discord, facebook page and YouTube channel all for this game!)

If you are *at all* interested in hunting games, I highly recommend getting this one. For the price, it’s a steal. And there’s seemingly a lot more to come too! Awesome game, hats off to the Developer.

The game is fun and very realistic compared to other hunting games. However, there are some things I think could make the game better, like a better trophy lodge and improvements to the trail camera system. For the trophy lodges, I wish you could make them mounts like two deer fighting and maybe make it so you can freely walk around and look at whatever you want. You could also maybe make them so they can be custom and not everyones looks the same. It would be very cool if they had tree stands and saddles for bow hunting, it would make it more fun. For the trail cameras, I wish there was a gallery that you could visit and see the deer on camera. And I also am not sure if the deer stay the same each time you play the game and if you can watch them grow but if you can't it would be nice to add that. Overall the game is very enjoyable but I would love for those features to be added and I would play the game even more and it would be much more enjoyable

This is probably one of the funnest time killers I've played in a long while. It has a sense of depth and thought behind it that a lot of other games gloss over. When you start a season, you get the chance to prepare for that year's hunting, and what you do actually makes a difference. Each day is a whole new set of deer, which is cool in the fact that you wont run out of huge bucks, but you don't get the pleasure of watching them grow into bigger racks. I would recommend it to someone who is OK taking it slow and enjoying the scenery. 8/10 for me!
